falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low would invalidate the 73% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at 5,119; this would confirm structural weakness rather than a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at 38.57 but rapidly mean-revert; sustained elevated fear would contradict the bottom_2024_aug pattern's quick volatility compression signal and indicate systemic stress instead

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts further below -50 basis points (more negative)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with curve steepening from deeply inverted levels; renewed flattening/inversion would signal deteriorating growth expectations and invalidate the cyclical recovery premise embedded in the pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
